import html # Pre‑defined HTML template with placeholders for event data. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title}

{event_title}

Date: {event_date}

{event_description}
{additional_notes_section}
""" def generate_event_html(title: str, description: str, date: str, extra_notes: str) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- title : str The name or heading of the event. description : str An extensive description of the event (may include multiple lines). date : str The date on which the event is scheduled. extra_notes : str Any extra information or instructions supplied by the user. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string that safely renders the event invitation. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to prevent HTML injection (CWE‑74). safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') safe_date = html.escape(date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(extra_notes, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Conditionally include the notes section only if provided. if safe_notes.strip(): additional_notes_section = f"
Additional Notes: {safe_notes}
" else: additional_notes_section = "" # Populate the template with sanitized values. html_content = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_date=safe_date, event_description=safe_description, additional_notes_section=additional_notes_section ) return html_content
